premise: Pinecone shuts tight when the rain comes and Bird thinks she's cross; Mushroom sneezes and explains, and when the sun comes out Pinecone opens wide again.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), taken gently and literally: the rain closes, the sun opens, and a misunderstanding clears with the sky.
lesson: What looks like a grump might just be a friend keeping dry.
learning: Pinecones close up when it is wet and open when it is dry

en-US.title: Pinecone Opens Up
en-US.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 12s} {pinecone:enter} Pinecone came rolling into the meadow, and {bird:enter} Bird {bird:go to pinecone} flew down to play. {pinecone:face happy} [happily] It was dry and bright, and {pinecone:live} Pinecone opened her scales wide, like a flower. {canvas:rain 0.6 26s} {sfx:rain-bed} Then, pitter-patter, the rain began, and she closed them up, snug and tight. {bird:face sad} [sad] Oh no, said Bird. Pinecone is cross with me. A little {mushroom:enter} mushroom popped up, and a raindrop tickled her cap. {mushroom:live} She scrunched her face… ah… ah… ACHOO! A puff of glitter, and a smile. [giggles] {mushroom:face happy} She isn't cross, said Mushroom. Pinecones close up when it's wet. Wait for the sun. {pinecone:face sleeping} So they waited. Drip… drop… drip. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} And then out came the sun, warm and golden. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] {pinecone:live hold} Slowly, slowly, Pinecone opened up again, one scale at a time, wide as a smile. {bird:face happy} {bird:live} Bird puffed up his chest and sang his happiest song. {squirrel:enter} Squirrel came bounding over, {squirrel:hop} and they all {all:hearts} played until bedtime.

es-ES.title: Piña se abre
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunshine 0.6 12s} {pinecone:enter} Piña llegó rodando por el prado, y {bird:enter} Pájaro {bird:go to pinecone} bajó volando a jugar. {pinecone:face happy} [happily] Hacía un día seco y luminoso, y {pinecone:live} Piña abrió bien sus escamas, como una flor. {canvas:rain 0.6 26s} {sfx:rain-bed} Entonces, plic, ploc, empezó la lluvia, y las cerró bien apretaditas. {bird:face sad} [sad] Ay, no, dijo Pájaro. Piña se ha enfadado conmigo. Una {mushroom:enter} setita brotó a su lado, y una gota le hizo cosquillas en el sombrero. {mushroom:live} Arrugó la cara… a… a… ¡ACHÍS! Un soplo de purpurina, y una sonrisa. [giggles] {mushroom:face happy} No está enfadada, dijo Seta. Las piñas se cierran cuando se mojan. Espera al sol. {pinecone:face sleeping} Esperaron. Plic… ploc… plic. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} Y entonces salió el sol, calentito y dorado. {bird:face surprised} [gasps] {pinecone:live hold} Poco a poco, Piña volvió a abrirse, escama a escama, grande como una sonrisa. {bird:face happy} {bird:live} Pájaro hinchó el pecho y cantó su canción más alegre. {squirrel:enter} Ardilla llegó dando brincos, {squirrel:hop} y todos {all:hearts} jugaron hasta la hora de dormir.

rain-bed.prompt: a light spring shower pattering on leaves and moss
